terminals.name: web
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv run python manage.py runserver 0.0.0.0:$(cat .dev_port 2>/dev/null || echo 8000)
terminals.description: Django dev server on the per-environment random port recorded in .dev_port (forward localhost:<port> -> container:<port>)

terminals.name: tailwind
terminals.command: export PATH="$HOME/.local/bin:$PATH"; uv run python manage.py tailwind start
terminals.description: Tailwind CSS watcher that rebuilds theme styles on change
